The card-ops-sweep skill and card-status procedure already define evidence-first triage; add a callable Ada-OCB tool to produce one timestamped summary of stuck, failed, and misplaced work without dispatching or mutating cards.

The Ada-OCB queue picker labels queued action.type=manual cards as queued for dispatch, while board runners reject them as unsupported. Make the response accurately identify human-only work without changing card state or inventing an executor.

Lock in this week's ada-ocb improvements (context_pack, ssot_get, windowed excerpts, MDDB lessons, vector-search, board snapshots, string-row guards) with regression coverage so they can't silently rot.
